description: Use when publishing, open-sourcing, exporting, sanitizing, or moving code, agent skills, prompts, templates, fixtures, datasets, workshop assets, or other artifacts from a private repository, vendor/runtime environment, or mixed working directory into a public repository or registry. Builds a provenance inventory, license/security review, explicit allowlist, clean staging package, approval dry run, and fresh public clone/install smoke. Triggers on "open source this", "publish these skills", "make this repo public", "export and sanitize", "подготовь публичный релиз", "выложи скиллы", "опенсорсни", "санитизируй и опубликуй". NOT for ordinary upstream bugfix PRs, vulnerability disclosure, or creating a corp-* department.
